html:
The Derg, "committee" in Ge'ez, was the military council that overthrew Emperor Haile Selassie in 1974 and ruled Ethiopia as a Marxist-Leninist state until 1987, with its leaders in power until 1991.

Army officers formed it in June 1974, amid mutinies, strikes and anger over a hidden famine. They deposed the emperor in September, executed some sixty former officials in November, and ended the monarchy of the Ethiopian Empire. In 1975 they nationalised all rural land and city property. Haile Selassie died in their custody in 1975.

Mengistu Haile Mariam took full control in 1977. With Soviet and Cuban help the Derg beat a Somali invasion of the Ogaden in 1977 and 1978. In the "Red Terror" of the same years it killed tens of thousands of suspected opponents. It also killed the patriarch of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church. Its wars against rebels in Eritrea and Tigray, forced resettlement and grain policies made the famine of 1983 to 1985 far worse.

In 1987 the Derg was formally dissolved into a civilian People's Democratic Republic, still under Mengistu. Rebels took Addis Ababa in May 1991, and he fled to Zimbabwe. Through all of it, Ethiopian Airlines kept flying and making a profit.
sum: The Derg, "committee" in Ge'ez, was the military council that overthrew Emperor Haile Selassie in 1974 and ruled Ethiopia as a Marxist-Leninist state until 1987, with its leaders in power until 1991.
